subject: Re: Mechanic kickoff — A/B results, one workload is stubborn
body:
A/B status across the three workloads:

- Retrieval encoder (batch 4096, cosine schedule): mechanized adamw matches the hand-tuned baseline within 0.1% eval loss, zero sweep cost. Clear win.
- Ranking model (batch 512, linear warmup): Mechanic beats the production LR by 0.8% — turns out prod was under-tuned for a year. Slightly awkward, very persuasive.
- Small-batch fine-tune (batch 64): the scale factor oscillates early and we land 1.2% worse unless we extend warmup. Quentin traced it to the schedule interaction — remember Mechanic tunes the scale, so a base_learning_rate left at 1e-4 instead of 1.0 silently double-scales; one team hit exactly that misconfiguration in dogfood.

Risk: rollout doc must make the "set base LR to 1.0" contract impossible to miss, ideally with a startup assertion. Wanjiru is adding one.

Recommendation stays: default-on for large-batch, opt-in for batch < 128.

Rafael
